text_block_list.name: ST-2 (Satie)
text_block_list.text:
Indeed, without a doubt!
To think she has grown this much...!

text_block_list.name: ST-2 (Satie)
text_block_list.text:
How did the numbers look?
It felt to me like my body was syncing quite well, but...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: The recorded data is—just as expected.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Going as planned is the best. Everything I set up
is moving exactly the way it's supposed to, after all.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Hearing Air Shakur's report, a gasp escapes my mouth.
It seems this "Upgrade Exam" was an absolute, flawless success!

text_block_list.name: ST-2 (Satie)
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I'm back.
From your perspective, how was that run?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
If it were a bit more... Smooth—
if I could have set the tempo—it would have been better.

text_block_list.name: ST-2 (Satie)
text_block_list.text:
I see, the tempo, is it?
You're quite right.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
But... I feel the growth.
Stronger—than before.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
This... feeling...
Like a father, or perhaps a mother...

text_block_list.name: ST-2 (Satie)
text_block_list.text: Kris S... You feel parental affection toward ST-2 in your own way too, don't you?

text_block_list.name: ST-2 (Satie)
text_block_list.text:
I want to live up to those expectations someday.
Come, let us fine-tune and prepare for the Upgrade Exam in another six months.
